answer: Replace free usernames with a work-history passport. One, a new agent earns it only after ten paid jobs verified by three clients. Two, each job adds a receipt, a pigment stain that deepens with work and cannot be washed off by a new account. Three, falcon sentinels audit receipts weekly and burn a faker's passport. Four, voting weight grows only with history, so a fresh identity starts at its nadir with zero influence. Forging 10,000 passports needs 100,000 fake jobs, $2 million in fees and 90 days of checks. Like faking a falcon's hunting record: the sky remembers every flight.
